title: cloudflare speed cli: CLI for internet speed test via cloudflare

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Need to check your internet speed fast? Meet Cloudflare-SP Speed TLI. The command line tool that tests your download and upload speeds in a TUI interface. It shows you real-time charts with download upload throughput, idle latency, and loaded latency all in one place. No more guessing, just real data real quick. Track results, export as JSON, and even script
